name: Electrolux
h1: A new APAC region deserves a connected way to run it
lede: Electrolux stood up Region APAC in January 2026, focused on marketing, sales and product lines, with new leadership based in Bangkok. This is the moment to set up shared plans before legacy spreadsheets take root.
why_h2: A new region, a new leader, growing volumes
why_p: Region APAC is less than a year old, its leadership changed mid-year and volumes grew in Q2. Each signal points to launches and campaigns that need one shared system.

signals.title: Region APAC created
signals.body: Electrolux split its former Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East and Africa business area into Region EMEA and Region APAC, effective 1 January 2026. APAC focuses on marketing, sales and product lines.
signals.angle: New regions need shared plans and trackers before legacy spreadsheets take root.

signals.title: Bernard Chong to lead Region APAC
signals.body: Bernard Chong, formerly President Greater China at Dyson, joined Electrolux on 1 June 2026 to lead Region APAC from Bangkok.
signals.angle: A new leader setting priorities is the moment to consolidate how work is run across markets.

signals.title: APAC volumes up in Q2
signals.body: Electrolux reported second-quarter 2026 growth driven by higher sales volumes in EMEA, APAC and Latin America, while North America declined.
signals.angle: Growth regions scale faster when campaigns and product launches live in one connected system.
signals.src: Electrolux Group Q2 2026 interim report, Jul 2026
